# Nutrition label mode: accuracy (Nutrition MVP)

**Source of every number here: synthetic.** Labels were generated by a seeded script (no third-party data, no photo,
no person). Real label photos have NOT been measured: that needs the owner's 200-photo set (design §5.1, §11).
Nothing here may be presented as accuracy on real labels.

- Fixed test set, locked 2026-11-12 BEFORE `lensiq-nut.js` / `nutrition.html` existed: `~/LENSIQ-field/evals/nutrition/`
  (outside the repo; README.md there = contract, metrics and targets; `locked.sha256` sha256 =
  `19f1ff55dbf22c4940376fcf511d227a81dc194e64065ea3d8e19fe7d3c2f159` before the in-repo test hashes were appended).
- Run once: `node tools/nut-eval.mjs` (checks the lock first), commit of the run on branch `nutrition-mvp`, Apple M1,
  headless Chrome, ONNX Runtime Web WASM, 1 thread. NOT a phone. No tuning on this set.
- Parts: T = 210 labels as ideal text -> parser; I = 140 rendered PNGs -> the page's on-device path (PP-OCRv5 det ->
  auto crop -> PP-OCRv5 rec, script th or cjk -> parser). Formats: Thai new (No. 445 style), Thai old (No. 182),
  Thai GDA, US, EU, China, Japan. Image conditions: clean, blur, glare, small, rotate 4°. Korean and Malaysian /
  Singapore panels are not covered.

## What fails

All 26 silent wrong values are on the 4° rotated pictures (9 labels: 4 cn, 4 jp, 1 eu). On a tilted panel with the name
on the left and the value on the right, the OCR's line grouping pairs a name with the NEXT row's value, so every value
shifts down one row and each is shown as "read" (e.g. China: fat shows the carbohydrate value, sodium shows a gram
value). The parser accepts sodium printed in g without flagging it, which hid part of this. Thai panels (name and value
on one text run) are not affected. The missed allergen statements are also on rotated pictures (2 / 6 found).

## Next step (not built: it needs the owner's decision, see the round report)

Candidate fixes, to be measured on a NEW synthetic set (this one is used up for tuning purposes): pair names and values
by the tilt of the OCR boxes instead of the line grouping; flag "please check" when a whole column looks shifted
(units that do not fit the field, energy vs macros) or when the picture is tilted beyond ~2°; never accept sodium in g
silently. Real-photo measurement still needs the owner's 200 photos.

## Round 2 (2026-11-13): tilt fix, option (a), measured on a NEW locked set (v2)

Coordinator instruction 2026-11-13 (branch only; nothing ships until the owner decides). Fix: rows are paired along the
picture's tilt (`LQNut.linesFromParts`: the angle that lines up box centres across rows and box edges down columns);
a tilt above 2.5° marks every value "please check" (why "tilt"); a unit that does not fit its field (sodium in g, salt in
mg, …) is never accepted silently; two or more such units mark the label's values "please check" (why "shifted").
Developed against the v1 images (now dev data only). Measured ONCE on v2: `~/LENSIQ-field/evals/nutrition/v2/`
(196 new PNGs, fresh seeds, 7 conditions = v1's 5 + 2° and 6° tilt; `locked.sha256` sha256
`4ae9a25fcb3eda7e5dec7871b7935b2ebf74df8913e3c99dbfebb888b3ec873c`, locked before the fix with tests/unit/nut-tilt.test.js).
Source: synthetic.

| # | Target | v2 result | Met? |
|---|---|---|---|
| I1 | Thai new: energy, sugar, sodium, fat >= 90 % each | 27 / 28 = 96.4 % each (tilt2 alone 3 / 4) | yes (pooled) |
| **I2** | silent wrong, Wilson upper <= 3 % pooled | **9 / 911 = 1.0 % [0.5–1.9]** | **yes, pooled** |
| I2 | same bar per format / condition | th-new 7 / 118 [2.9–11.7] no; th-old 2 / 123 [0.4–5.7] no; blur 4 / 175 [0.9–5.7] no; tilt2 5 / 185 [1.2–6.2] no; us, eu, clean, glare, small: 0 errors and upper <= 3 % yes; th-gda, cn, jp: 0 errors, n too small; rotate 4° and tilt 6°: every value "please check", 0 read | partly |
| I3 | allergen statement found >= 95 %, 0 false | 87 / 92 = 94.6 % [87.9–97.7], 0 false (tilt2 11 / 14) | no (just below) |
| I4 | exact match | all 90.7 % (v1 before the fix: 82.2 %); clean 93.0, blur 89.1, glare 91.1, small 90.6, rotate 4° 93.0, tilt 2° 85.8, tilt 6° 92.1 % | reported |

What is left (all 9 errors are "phantom" reads, none on the 4° / 6° pictures):
- OCR misreads "ไขมันอิ่มตัว" as "ไขมันอื่มตัว" / "ไขมันอ่มตัว"; the parser then reads that line as a SECOND total-fat value
  (equal values, so it was not flagged as a duplicate): 4 of 9, blur (Thai sat fat exact is also low, 36–43 %).
- One 2°-tilted Thai panel whose misread header made the parser take the values as "per pack" (5 of 9).
Candidate fixes (not built in this round; they need a third fresh set to be measured): accept the common misreads of
"อิ่มตัว"; never read "ไขมัน" + other Thai letters as total fat; flag two values for one field even when equal; accept
"per pack" only with a pack word ("ซอง", "ถุง", "ห่อ", …).

## Round 3 (2026-11-13): four small fixes, measured on a THIRD locked set (v3)

Fixes (coordinator instruction, option 1, branch only): common OCR misreads of "อิ่มตัว" read as saturated fat; "ไขมัน"
followed by other Thai letters is never total fat; two values for one field are "please check" even when equal; "per
pack" only with a pack word (ซอง, ถุง, ห่อ, กล่อง, ขวด, ถ้วย, …). Developed against v1 / v2 (dev data only). Measured ONCE on
v3: `~/LENSIQ-field/evals/nutrition/v3/` (252 new PNGs, new seeds; 8 labels per condition for Thai new and Thai old,
4 for the other formats; same 7 conditions; `locked.sha256` sha256
`4ed1b1790865586a7242098943fc2aa3c9dd3698d13cd971e17c08e38fcab8c3`, locked before the fixes with
tests/unit/nut-fix3.test.js). Source: synthetic.

| # | Target | v3 result | Met? |
|---|---|---|---|
| I1 | Thai new: energy, sugar, sodium, fat >= 90 % each | 56 / 56 each, every condition 8 / 8 | yes |
| I2 | silent wrong, Wilson upper <= 3 % pooled | 0 / 1245 [0.0–0.3] | yes |
| I2 | per format | th-new 0 / 276 [0–1.4], th-old 0 / 292 [0–1.3], us 0 / 138 [0–2.7], eu 0 / 260 [0–1.5] yes; th-gda 0 / 69, cn 0 / 103, jp 0 / 107: zero errors, n too small to show the bar | yes where n allows |
| I2 | per condition | clean 0 / 265, blur 0 / 239, glare 0 / 246, small 0 / 243, tilt 2° 0 / 252 (all upper <= 1.6 %); rotate 4° and tilt 6°: every value "please check", none read | yes |
| I3 | allergen statement found >= 95 %, 0 false | 102 / 109 = 93.6 % [87.3–96.9], 0 false | **no** |
| I4 | exact match | all 93.3 %; th-new 99.0, th-old 94.0, th-gda 98.2, us 88.8, eu 95.6, cn 83.6, jp 84.0 %; clean 95.4, blur 95.1, glare 93.0, small 94.4, rotate 4° 92.0, tilt 2° 90.7, tilt 6° 92.3 % | reported |

I3 misses: 5 of 7 are Thai panels at 2° tilt and 2 are Japanese; in every case the OCR misread the statement's keyword
("ข้อมูลสำหรับผู้พ้อาหาร" for "ผู้แพ้อาหาร"; "アレルギ一物質" with the kanji 一 for the long-vowel mark ー), so the statement was not
recognised and the card said "no allergen text found … that does not mean there is none". No false statement. Candidate
fix (not built: it needs a fourth fresh set): accept those keyword misreads.
